# Stefano Ramirez

> Software engineer based in Costa Rica working across the full software development lifecycle, with a current focus on AI-powered products and agentic systems that integrate Claude, GPT, and Gemini into production workflows. Stack: React, TypeScript, Astro, Cloudflare.
